steps.title: Configure App Meta Info
steps.description: Align app-meta.json with app name 'Native Image Text Replacer' and package 'com.nativeimagetextreplacer.app'.

steps.title: Add Internet Permissions to Manifest
steps.description: Declare INTERNET and ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE permissions in AndroidManifest.xml to authorize Online OCR requests and Offline data downloads.

steps.title: Update UI Workspace Layout
steps.description: Redesign activity_main.xml to introduce an OCR Mode Spinner, download status headers, and an active progress indicator bar.

steps.title: Implement Online OCR Uploader
steps.description: Add a multi-part stream uploader in MainActivity.java to securely send image bytes to secure cloud endpoints with real-time feedback.

steps.title: Implement Offline OCR Download Manager
steps.description: Create a background stream downloader that fetches bilingual (Hindi + English) dictionary packages and stores them permanently.

steps.title: Build Auto OCR Fallback Pipelines
steps.description: Integrate network availability checks that auto-route OCR queries to Offline backup modes if cloud connections fail.

steps.title: Update EditorView OCR Engine
steps.description: Add advanced performance-driven bilingual text boundaries mapping that segments English and Hindi content dynamically.

steps.title: Verify Style & Color Palettes
steps.description: Ensure the selected text editor colors, bold toggles, alignments, and text block drag handles remain fully operational.

steps.title: Verify Brush Remover & Overlays
steps.description: Verify brush sweep coordinates sampling and multi-layer overlays dragging/resizing parameters.

steps.title: Verify Java 8 Source Compatibility
steps.description: Ensure all added asynchronous threads utilize strict Java 8 anonymous inner classes instead of modern lambdas.

steps.title: Verify Gradle Configurations
steps.description: Confirm compileSdkVersion 34 and AGP compatibility parameters match the workspace environment.

steps.title: Building Native Image Text Replacer
steps.description: Compile the full bilingual dual-mode OCR application utilizing target environment specifications.
